BrochureContent.Content:
For sale by Public Auction on Wednesday 2 September 2026 at 14:00 at The Club House Hotel, Kilkenny (unless previously sold)

The Farm at Newtown, Bonnettstown occupies an attractive setting in one of County Kilkenny's most productive farming districts, approximately 5 km east of Kilkenny City. Benefiting from fertile soils and a gently rolling landscape, the area has supported agricultural activity for generations and remains a highly regarded farming location.

Characterised by mature hedgerows, well-defined field boundaries and a pleasant rural aspect, the property captures the appeal of traditional Kilkenny farmland while remaining within easy reach of the city and wider transport network. The lands form part of a historic agricultural landscape associated with the wider Bonnettstown area.

Having been carefully managed by the current owners, Lot 1 presents a rare opportunity to acquire a versatile holding comprising productive grassland and attractive amenity features. The property offers broad appeal to a range of purchasers, including farmers, equestrian interests, lifestyle buyers, and those seeking environmental, recreational, or long-term investment value.

Extending to about 37.8 acres, Lot 1 comprises an attractive parcel of productive agricultural land, laid out in a series of well-sized fields. The lands are predominantly in grass and are bounded by mature hedgerows, creating a well-defined and easily managed holding.

• Excellent silage ground
  • Ideal for equestrian use
  • Ring-fenced block of land
  • Idyllic surroundings
  • Accessible location
